card.name: Greek letters and split-up drug terms
card.fires_on: Responds to a Greek letter such as β or μ that comes before a hyphen in terms like beta-lactam, beta-blocker or mu-opioid. Also fires on the middle piece of a split-up word such as conceive or coagulation.
